title: Feed mutations silently ignore persistence failures
reasoning: The add, edit, and delete flows all suppress SwiftData save errors and the UI dismisses as if the operation succeeded. Delete is worse because it can still notify Ghostwriter that a feed was deleted even when the local save failed, leaving local and remote state divergent. The unique URL constraint gives a concrete user path where a save can fail, such as adding an already-existing feed URL, with no error surfaced.
reproduction: Try adding a feed whose URL already exists, or force a SwiftData save failure during feed deletion; the sheet/row flow completes without an error and deletion can still be sent to Ghostwriter.
recommendation: Handle save errors explicitly before dismissing or making remote side effects. For deletion, save local changes first and only notify Ghostwriter after a successful save; surface failures in an alert and keep the user in context.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: App/Tests/EpilogueTests.swift only asserts true, and the screenshot UI test only captures screens; neither exercises feed add/edit/delete failures or remote notification ordering.
suggestedRegressionTest: Add a feed-management test that attempts a duplicate URL and asserts the form remains visible with an error, plus a deletion test with a failing model context/coordinator spy asserting notifyFeedDeleted is not called after local save failure.
minimumFixScope: FeedListView add, edit, and delete persistence paths plus focused tests around failed saves.
